integrations.how.title: How to add a key
integrations.how.1: Get the value from the service (the card tells you where).
integrations.how.2: Paste it into the box under its name and press Save. It is stored in Vercel as a write-only secret. For local work, put it in .env.local instead.
integrations.how.3: Press Deploy now, wait a minute, then press Re-check. The status turns to Set. This page never shows a saved value again.
integrations.how.warn: Paste keys only into the boxes on this page, never into chat or email. If one leaks, rotate it in the service straight away.
integrations.setupSaving: To paste keys on this page, add VERCEL_API_TOKEN in Vercel once (see the card at the bottom). Until then, add keys in Vercel by hand.
integrations.saved: Saved to Vercel. It reaches the live app after the next deploy.
integrations.err.invalid: That value is not valid. Paste it on one line, with no spaces around it.
integrations.err.not_configured: Saving is not set up yet. Add VERCEL_API_TOKEN and VERCEL_TEAM_ID in Vercel once.
integrations.err.rejected: Vercel refused it. Check the token has access to this project.
integrations.err.network: Could not reach Vercel. Try again in a minute.
integrations.deploy.pending: Keys saved. Deploy so the live app can use them.
integrations.deploy.started: Deploying now. It takes about a minute. Then press Re-check.
integrations.deploy.error: Could not start the deploy. Open Vercel and press Redeploy.
